evidence_scope: Production algorithm bodies and JSON store in optimized synthetic CLI probes; end-to-end SQLite/JSON conservation regression. No installed-release profiling or FPS measurement this round. Prior worktree changes preserved.

microbenchmarks.repetitions: Five timing observations, median, except the 12000-node dense chain and save are one observation per process. Timings are diagnostics, not CI thresholds.
microbenchmarks.family_fixture: 4000 paths; independent parent chains of 16 nodes; 8,64,256 distinct requested IDs (last size includes six missing roots). 60 deterministic random functional graphs, cycles/self-loops/orphans, filename/header fallback, archived paths, 12000-deep chain, dense 12000-request one-leaf chain.
microbenchmarks.json_fixture: 128000 rows,128 distinct lexical day keys,1000 paths; four prefixes including legacy openclaw. Four query APIs checked against row-based oracle, plus mutations, collisions, save/reload/reset. Date sorting is warmed before timing.
microbenchmarks.rss_note: These peaks include oracle data, dense-chain checks, temporary query results and allocator high-water behavior; no memory-reduction claim. Separate smaller identical fixed-workload process RSS is reported in Instruments comparison.

instruments_fixed_workload.work: 10 batches of 64 Codex IDs over4000 paths/depth16; seed128000 Claude rows;1000 single-day queries; identical checksum16163840. Includes startup, setup, seed and final checks.
instruments_fixed_workload.limitations: Single Time Profiler recording per arm on CLI main thread. Real IslandLiveModel runs these functions on a detached utility worker; no UI-main-thread or whole fetch latency claim. Inclusive weights overlap. No SQL or rollout-header I/O in family-routing probe. Concurrent tests/builds/system work and sampling affect observations. RSS observations are separate launches without Instruments.

complexity.family_before: Expected O(Q*P*L) Claude path matching and O(Q*P*(L+Hchain)) Codex ancestor matching, plus model merging.
complexity.family_after: Each file routed once; each parent node resolved once. Shared immutable requested-ancestor links require O(H+Q) graph storage instead of copying requested-ID sets per node; routing still pays for requested memberships and their model merges. Path/filename string processing remains. Dense requested ancestry is not free.
complexity.json_before: Each range query scans R corpus rows.
complexity.json_after: Warm narrow window O(log D + Rwindow); first use after date membership changes adds O(D log D). Wide windows fall back to O(R). Additional O(R+D) date index storage; maintained during mutations/reload. 1/16 row-count crossover is a measured heuristic, not universal hardware tuning.
